main_subject.description: An original adult woman with long wavy honey-blonde hair, soft curtain bangs, neutral glowing makeup, and a candid gentle expression; she must not resemble a real public figure.

technical_specs.quality: high-detail natural skin, linen and wood textures, soft cinematic depth

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 interior fashion portrait of an original adult woman who does not resemble a public figure. She has long wavy honey-blonde hair with soft curtain bangs, neutral glowing makeup, and a gentle candid expression. She wears a cream ruffled long-sleeve blouse with a high neckline, beige tailored trousers, white crew socks, and simple unbranded gold earrings. Pose her sitting sideways on a vintage wooden chair beside a small wooden desk, elbow lightly resting on the desktop and looking just off camera. Set the scene in a cozy room with white wood-paneled walls, dark wood trim, polished hardwood floor, and softly blurred white linen on a bed. Use warm natural window light, gentle bokeh, detailed natural textures, and no text, logos, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, Sabrina Carpenter, minor, corset, camisole, bloomers, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, readable text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, distorted anatomy
